messages:
Tess: quick alert — saw dashboard panel flash another tenant's rows while switching orgs fast :grimacing:
Tess: repro steps in case helpful: load panel as org A, quick-switch to org B, open panel -> shows org A rows
Ravi: saw this too on canary. short log:
Ravi: ```
INFO prefetch key=/api/panel/9 hit cache payload. payload.org=orgA
INFO request.user=orgB served cached payload.org=orgA
```
Nina: root cause looks like cache key omitted tenant id (path-only). simple but nasty
Jules: mitigation: pause canary and add guard to not cache if tenant mismatch, plus include tenant in key
deploy-bot: rollout:prefetch-prefill -> ramped to 30% at 2026-03-22T09:10:00Z
deploy-bot: rollback:prefetch-prefill -> initiated at 2026-03-22T09:27:12Z by @Jules :white_check_mark:
Ravi: proposed quick code change: cacheKey = `${tenant}|${method}|${url}`; also assert response.org == tenant before set
Nina: I'll grep for other path-only caches (widget cache, aggregator, telemetry client) and file follow-ups
Tess: created ENG-8012 to track fix, test, and audit
Jules: owners: Nina (audit + PR), Ravi (repro + fix), Tess (incident + telemetry), Jules (release)
security-team: acknowledged, will join postmortem and confirm exposure window
Tess: thanks all, will update when PR lands and staging stress runs pass
